item.title:
Me: eating my latkes and shitposting about how someone should build a GPT-powered MyFitnessPal killer.

Meanwhile: 17-year-old @zach_yadegari, @henrylangmack, @blakeandersonw, and @jakecastilloooo build and scale Cal AI past $50M ARR in 18 months.

That’s the way 🙌
